content_text: That was a location that had to be lit as we shot all the scenes in one day. Naturally, the daylight would not have been sufficient for nor would it have been reliable. I remember we used a line of 12K HMIs on one side but I’m not sure what the overhead source was. I suspect we used a lighting balloon. I have rarely used balloons but I think I did in this church as there was no possibility of rigging inside or accessing the roof.
